title: [AUT-004] Prove and release the fully automated auditable workflow
objective: Demonstrate the user's end state: an installed configurable tool completes authorized development work without routine human handoffs and explains every outcome.
inScope: Run an acceptance matrix against the installed release candidate in an independent consumer and the migrated Fantasy Football integration. After documented one-time setup/credentials and a scoped execution grant, complete a representative dependency chain using a real headless provider through Developer, deterministic validation, required independent reviews, publication/CI and controlled completion.

Prove no routine clipboard exchange, manual role switching, response import, per-task assignment, push/PR creation or merge confirmation is required within the configured policy. Do not count a fake-provider test or the retired live canary as this proof.

Exercise bounded review/validation rework, durable stop/resume, process restart, duplicate work, unavailable provider, stale head/CI, denied/revoked policy, budget exhaustion and uncertain merge. Deterministic fault injection may prove failures; identify exactly which scenarios use real integrations.
Have a fresh maintainer inspect why work ran, what changed, who/which role judged it, which configuration/package/policy applied, and why each gate passed/stopped, with redacted audit export.

Publish the supported unattended release, provider/runtime support matrix, upgrade/rollback playbook and exception procedures. Document manual fallback as an option, not a hidden required stage. Cross-link #74/#75 and the roadmap with precise achieved/deferred capability boundaries.
**Expected surfaces:** Installed end-to-end acceptance harness/reports, genuine task/review/CI/merge evidence, release artifacts and operations/support docs.
outOfScope: No claim of perfect autonomy for ambiguous requirements, no new canary acceptance prerequisite, distributed deployment or release by test fixture assertion.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: A real authorized dependent-task chain completes through exact-head controlled merge/DONE with zero routine human handoffs after the initial grant.
AC-02: All required role judgments are independently sourced from fresh role contexts and validated against the final revision.
AC-03: Restart, rework and uncertain-outcome tests preserve audit history and avoid duplicate effects; failures do not become PASS.
AC-04: Policy-denied/expired/revoked or over-budget work stops with an actionable durable reason and no unauthorized effects.
AC-05: A fresh operator can install, configure, inspect audit evidence, pause/drain, resume and safely roll back using docs alone.
AC-06: Fantasy Football remains a pinned consumer with no embedded engine, and release evidence distinguishes M1 extraction from achieved M2 automation.
validationPlan:
Record per-scenario package checksum, source SHAs, grant/config digest, task/run/session/evidence references, actual human interventions and result. Require independent QA, Architecture and UAT acceptance of the final release; test replay/reconciliation after DONE and inspect the package payload.

Use applicable repository build/test/schema/contract checks. Retain exact commands/results, package/source/config identities and an acceptance-to-evidence map. Existing or fake-provider fixtures are not independent live review or task-completion evidence. This task is normal feature work, not a new canary requirement.
npm run build; npm test; python schemas/validate_fixtures.py; python schemas/validate_repository_contracts.py; npm run test:adversarial:mutations. Add issue-specific checks before admission.
